The existing `Driver` runs that stage with the lock-held session's shared provider/cooldown payload, so cost, effects, watchdog, and served identity follow the same production route as every other stage; no artifact registration or second client is added. `squatch/__main__.py::_drain` constructs the production hook with the main repo, journal, clock, filesystem, Git/Effects, Box, Driver, and that session payload and passes it into `Drain`; direct Drain construction defaults the hook off for focused tests, while every newly self-upgraded CLI child rebinds it, so the hook is live from this merge onward.

The invoker runs an UNFORCED due check at the top of every dispatch iteration before the next ticket dispatch. It runs only when the current window has at least N=25 merged tickets, is at least M=7 days old, or one signal kind reaches S=5 in that window; the per-kind identities are exactly one used non-empty `gate_bypass`, one Rework invocation/order, one terminal `state_transition` with `to: gate_failed`, or one admission whose conflict facts carry integration-red implicated paths. It also runs one FORCED retro at quiescence and immediately before dispatch of any phase-exit ticket, but only when a merge landed after the latest completed retro report. Success commits exactly one report and advances the window boundary. Failure appends one `signal` keyed `retro-failed/<window-boundary>/<trigger>` with body `{kind: retro_failed, window_boundary, trigger, error_code}`, enqueues exactly one signature-deduped `failure_report` Box message carrying that identity and a bounded redacted summary, and suppresses every further due/forced attempt in the same window; only a later `retro/<seq>` completion boundary releases suppression. This failure route is part of the invoker fence and never draws an unbounded ticketless retry loop.

The activation adds tombstone auto-reopen and one `retro_finding` per proposal carrying `retro_report_key`, `fixed_failure`, `overcorrection_risk`, and `proposed_spec_paths`. Each proposal gets `proposal_id = sha256(canonical_json(retro_report_key, fixed_failure, overcorrection_risk, sorted(proposed_spec_paths)))[:16]` and Box origin `retro-proposal/<retro_report_key>/<proposal_id>`; because Box signatures include origin, replay of the same proposal dedups while proposals differing only in numbers or spec paths remain distinct. Box owns one `record_rereport` path used both by enqueue-signature hits and the semantic-triage tombstone match; on the K-th hit it appends `tombstone_auto_reopened` through an injected journal-backed callback BEFORE clearing the resolution, and every production Box constructor in the fenced stage/runner/daemon/drain/serve/CLI paths receives that same callback. The reopened record carries `reopened_from_tombstone: true`; triage/Author pass that marker to `policy.starting_state`, which returns `draft` regardless of the normal message-class row, then clears the one-shot marker only after authoring succeeds.

Authoring a ticket from a `retro_finding` appends one bridge `signal` keyed `retro-ticket/<ticket-stem>` with body `{kind: retro_ticket_authored, box_id, retro_report_key, ticket_stem}` before the authored-ticket resolution is committed. This journal bridge is the sole provenance lookup: Merge never receives or constructs a Box. At the existing successful merge-admission point in `squatch/merge.py`, after the real squash SHA and changed paths are known but before the merged terminal is journaled, a ticket whose source is exactly `box:retro_finding`, whose admitted diff changes at least one path under `specs/` ending in `.md`, and whose unique `retro_ticket_authored` bridge exists appends one `signal` keyed `retro-prompt-spec-change/<ticket-stem>/<squash-sha>`. Its body is exactly `{kind: retro_prompt_spec_change_merged, box_id, retro_report_key, ticket_stem, squash_sha, changed_spec_paths}`; `changed_spec_paths` is the sorted non-empty tuple of those `specs/*.md` paths, and the deterministic key makes replay idempotent. A missing or ambiguous bridge is a hard merge finding, never provenance inferred from the stem.
